contextual-editorial-identification.basis: Bounded contextual editorial identification within research and criticism; not a permissive-license claim.
contextual-editorial-identification.purpose: Identify the subjects of the substantive adjacent company and product reviews. See the per-asset purpose and page scope.
contextual-editorial-identification.distribution: Public website and public GitHub source repository were considered.
contextual-editorial-identification.amount: One website identification mark, displayed at 24 by 24 px. The whole small mark is needed for recognition; no unrelated source artwork.
contextual-editorial-identification.alternatives: Text names and initials remain usable, but lose the recognition aid requested for this comparison. The mark does not replace explanation or sourcing.
contextual-editorial-identification.nature: Public corporate or product identification icon, not unreleased work or a full brand kit.
contextual-editorial-identification.likelyEffect: Small referential display with adjacent official links; does not substitute for the source, sell the mark or suggest sponsorship.
contextual-editorial-identification.limitations: Copyright and trademark remain with the owner. Public availability alone is not permission. This is an editorial assessment, not legal assurance; reassess if monetized or repurposed.
